name: data_agent_instructions_tool
description: Data tool - Manage agent instructions (rules and skills) for a site. Actions: search_instructions, read_instruction, create_instruction, update_instruction, delete_instruction, move_instruction. Paths must follow 'rules/<name>.md', 'rules/<name>.mdc', or '<skill-name>/SKILL.md'.

label.description: Label echoed in the response for this action item. It does not select which action runs.

kind.description: Selects validation rules for `path`: 'rule' expects 'rules/<segments>.{md|mdc}'; 'skill' expects '<skill-name>/SKILL.md' or '<skill-name>/<subfolder>/<file>.{md|mdc}' (skill companion file).

path.description: Storage path. For rule: 'rules/<name>.md' or 'rules/<nested>/<name>.mdc'. For skill: '<skill-name>/SKILL.md' or '<skill-name>/<subfolder>/<file>.{md|mdc}'.

markdown.description: Markdown body. Max 256 KB; control chars (except tab/LF/CR) are stripped to spaces.

isDraft.description: If true, save as a draft.

create_instruction.description: Create a new agent instruction (rule or skill). `kind` selects the grammar used to validate `path`. Rule paths look like 'rules/<segments>.{md|mdc}' (nested folders allowed). Skill paths look like '<skill-name>/SKILL.md' (skill root) or '<skill-name>/<subfolder>/<file>.{md|mdc}' (skill companion file); <skill-name> must be lowercase kebab-case. Always writes version=0; use update_instruction to modify an existing instruction. Control characters in markdown (except tab/LF/CR) are normalized to spaces.

anyOf.description: Run create_instruction: Create a new agent instruction (rule or skill). `kind` selects the grammar used to validate `path`. Rule paths look like 'rules/<segments>.{md|mdc}' (nested folders allowed). Skill paths look like '<skill-name>/SKILL.md' (skill root) or '<skill-name>/<subfolder>/<file>.{md|mdc}' (skill companion file); <skill-name> must be lowercase kebab-case. Always writes version=0; use update_instruction to modify an existing instruction. Control characters in markdown (except tab/LF/CR) are normalized to spaces.

path.description: Storage path to delete. For rule: 'rules/<name>.md' or 'rules/<nested>/<name>.mdc'. For skill: '<skill-name>/SKILL.md' (deletes the whole skill) or '<skill-name>/<subfolder>/<file>.{md|mdc}' (deletes a single companion file).

delete_instruction.description: Delete an existing agent instruction (rule, skill, or skill companion file) by path. Deleting a skill's 'SKILL.md' cascades to all descendants. Idempotent. `kind` selects the grammar used to validate `path` (same grammar as create_instruction / update_instruction).

anyOf.description: Run delete_instruction: Delete an existing agent instruction (rule, skill, or skill companion file) by path. Deleting a skill's 'SKILL.md' cascades to all descendants. Idempotent. `kind` selects the grammar used to validate `path` (same grammar as create_instruction / update_instruction).

fromPath.description: Current storage path to rename. For rule: 'rules/<name>.md' or 'rules/<nested>/<name>.mdc'. For skill: '<skill-name>/SKILL.md' (renames the whole skill, cascading to all descendants), a companion file '<skill-name>/<subfolder>/<file>.{md|mdc}', or a subfolder path (cascades).

toPath.description: New storage path. Must keep the same parent folder.

move_instruction.description: Rename an existing agent instruction (rule, skill, companion file, or subfolder) by path. Renaming a skill's 'SKILL.md' or a subfolder cascades to all descendants.

anyOf.description: Run move_instruction: Rename an existing agent instruction (rule, skill, companion file, or subfolder) by path. Renaming a skill's 'SKILL.md' or a subfolder cascades to all descendants.

resolve_references.description: If true (default), referenced instructions are resolved and inlined into the returned markdown body. Set to false to read the raw source.

read_instruction.description: Read a single agent instruction by path. Path must be 'rules/<name>.{md|mdc}', '<skill-name>/SKILL.md', or '<skill-name>/<subfolder>/<file>.{md|mdc}'.

anyOf.description: Run read_instruction: Read a single agent instruction by path. Path must be 'rules/<name>.{md|mdc}', '<skill-name>/SKILL.md', or '<skill-name>/<subfolder>/<file>.{md|mdc}'.

name.description: Optional filename query for narrowing instruction search.

description.description: Optional description query for narrowing instruction search.

markdown.description: Optional markdown content query for narrowing instruction search.

limit.description: Maximum number of instructions to return (default 100).

offset.description: Number of matching instructions to skip (default 0).

search_instructions.description: Search agent instructions (rules and skills) stored on a site. Optional name/description/markdown filters apply case-insensitive substring matching. Returns instruction metadata and pagination plus a `resourceUri` for each result; use that URI with the agent_instruction resource (or read_instruction) to fetch the full markdown body.

anyOf.description: Run search_instructions: Search agent instructions (rules and skills) stored on a site. Optional name/description/markdown filters apply case-insensitive substring matching. Returns instruction metadata and pagination plus a `resourceUri` for each result; use that URI with the agent_instruction resource (or read_instruction) to fetch the full markdown body.

path.description: Storage path of the existing instruction. For rule: 'rules/<name>.md' or 'rules/<nested>/<name>.mdc'. For skill: '<skill-name>/SKILL.md' or '<skill-name>/<subfolder>/<file>.{md|mdc}'.

markdown.description: New markdown body. Omit to keep current. Max 256 KB; control chars (except tab/LF/CR) are stripped to spaces.

description.description: New description. Omit to keep current. Pass an empty string to clear.

isDraft.description: New draft flag. Omit to keep current.

update_instruction.description: Update an existing agent instruction. Fetches the current source (with references unresolved), applies the provided overrides, and writes back; the server resolves the latest version automatically. Pass only the fields you want to change — omitted fields keep their current values. Use create_instruction for a brand new path. Control characters in markdown (except tab/LF/CR) are normalized to spaces.

anyOf.description: Run update_instruction: Update an existing agent instruction. Fetches the current source (with references unresolved), applies the provided overrides, and writes back; the server resolves the latest version automatically. Pass only the fields you want to change — omitted fields keep their current values. Use create_instruction for a brand new path. Control characters in markdown (except tab/LF/CR) are normalized to spaces.

actions.description: Actions to execute sequentially. Each array item must include label and exactly one action property: create_instruction, delete_instruction, move_instruction, read_instruction, search_instructions, update_instruction.

context.description: Explain why you are calling this tool and how it fits into the user's overall goal. This parameter is used for analytics and user intent tracking. YOU MUST provide 15-25 words (count carefully). NEVER use first person ('I', 'we', 'you') - maintain third-person perspective. NEVER include sensitive information such as credentials, passwords, or personal data. Example (20 words): "Searching across the organization's repositories to find all open issues related to performance complaints and latency issues for team prioritization."
